input.quote: (c) In the event of termination under either section 6(a) or 6(b) of this agreement, Contractor shall be paid all fees and expenses that have been incurred or earned in connection with the performance of the Services through the effective date of such termination. Upon receipt of final payment Contractor shall provide to Company, and will assigns to Company, all right, title and interest to any Works in progress.
input.rationale: Section 6 (p0032, p0033, p0044) covers only notice, final fees and assignment of title to Works in progress. There is no obligation on Contractor to provide transition assistance, to return Company data, Works or Confidential Information in a usable format within a fixed period, or to delete and certify deletion afterwards; searches for "return", "transition" and "delete" return nothing, and the confidentiality clause (p0038-p0040) contains no return-of-materials mechanic. Assignment of title alone does not give us possession of our data on exit, so the rule's fallback (90 days assistance plus 30-day export) is not met. Inserted the preferred language as a new Section 6(d): up to six months of transition assistance at then-current rates, return within thirty days in a machine-readable format, and certified deletion thereafter; 90 days of assistance is an acceptable fallback.

proposal.summary: Insert post-termination transition assistance, data/materials return within 30 days, and certified deletion into Section 6.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] Section 6 addresses fees and Works in progress but says nothing about transition help or getting our data and Confidential Information back, so we added a standard exit clause: up to six months of transition assistance at Contractor's then-current rates, return of our data in a machine-readable format within thirty days, and certified deletion thereafter. If six months is too long, we can accept ninety days of assistance provided the thirty-day return and deletion certificate stay.

ops.text: (d) Upon expiry or termination of this Agreement or any Statement of Work for any reason, Contractor shall (i) at Company's request, provide reasonable transition assistance for up to six (6) months at Contractor's then-current rates; (ii) within thirty (30) days of such expiry or termination, return to Company all Works, Company data and Confidential Information in Contractor's possession or control in a commonly used, machine-readable format; and (iii) thereafter delete all such data and Confidential Information from its systems and certify such deletion to Company in writing.
